label: MAX MOVES
effect: More PvE jobs per session — faster mastery, cash and levels
buildMeaning: A build that runs more jobs per session to out-earn and out-level everyone else.
note: The safe economic path. Every point widens the pool you draw from to run jobs, so you clear more of the map per session and bank mastery faster.

label: MAX STAMINA
effect: Attack other players more often. Costs double — fighting cadence is an investment
buildMeaning: A build that can attack far more often, built to pressure other players.
note: The aggression path. Stamina gates how often you can attack another player, and it costs double on purpose — a fighting cadence should be a real investment.

label: MAX HEALTH
effect: Survive more rounds in turn-based fights. Resist hospitalization, poor to farm
buildMeaning: A build with a deep health pool that can endure more fights.
note: The defender identity. Combat is turn-based, so a deeper pool means you outlast attackers, resist hospitalization, and stop being worth farming.

label: ATTACK
effect: Damage dealt when you engage. Equipped gear dominates this total
buildMeaning: A base combat stat rather than a build of its own — gear carries most of this number.
note: Base combat stat. Equipped gear is expected to dominate your Attack total, so raw points here are a weak sink until tuned.

label: DEFENSE
effect: Damage reduced when you get hit. Equipped gear dominates this total
buildMeaning: A base combat stat rather than a build of its own — gear carries most of this number.
note: Base combat stat. Equipped gear is expected to dominate your Defense total, so raw points here are a weak sink until tuned.
